description: Identify suspicious, duplicate, incorrect, or disputable charges.
notes: Inlined Kit fallback implements the full contract and is active by design; app runs standalone with zero console errors (Playwright-verified).

notes.note: Contingency pricing (% of recovered overbilling) is the right model — it removes the trust barrier completely. Weakest assumption: acquisition. It's an episodic, high-friction product (upload your itemized bill) used once a year, and CAC will eat the contingency margin. Employer distribution is the only path that works.
Dispute-letter flow works: flagged upcode+duplicate, letter drafted, zero errors.

notes.change: Dispute outcomes now tracked per charge (Not sent/Sent/Under review/Resolved/Denied with date stamps, persisted) with a 'Recovered so far' total — README next-3 #3.
